'''2011 Yavin 4 Regionals Jeffrey Johns DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jeffrey Johns]] at [[2011 Yavin 4 Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (V) / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe (V)|VB4-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi-pre.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Fearless Leader
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
